readme.what_this_is: Everything Miraflores' pipeline would hand the workpaper for one client's 2025 return: the documents (as records), every value read from them, the client's answers and messages, prior-year records, tax agency records, firm settings, and the return as computed at three moments. It is pipeline output, not a workpaper: it contains no reviews, notes, sign-offs or decisions. Those are yours to design.
readme.all_data_is_invented: People, companies, numbers, SSNs (the 666 prefix is never issued), EINs, PTINs and accounts are fictional.
readme.truth_and_mistakes: documents[].pages[].printed_content states what is actually printed on each page. extracted_values states what the pipeline read, which can be wrong. return_versions reflect the engine's reading and rules, which can also be wrong. The packet contains mistakes with high confidence scores, as real pipeline output does.
readme.no_page_images: There are no page images. position values in extracted_values are synthetic: use them only to place highlights on a rendered representation of printed_content if you want to.
readme.engine_and_recomputing: Tax computations come from a simplified engine. Rate tables, thresholds and rules it used are in engine_reference; treat them as given. California AMT is not computed. You cannot rerun the engine: to show the tax effect of a change, multiply the change by the matching rate in return_versions[].tax_effect_rates (federal and California, per dollar). what_if holds engine results for specific alternatives.
readme.where_now_is: v3 (2026-06-23) is the latest engine output and the current return. Timeline events after that (client approval, e-file rejection and acceptance, payments, refunds, the 2028 examination letter) are scripted for replay; where they mention amounts, they mean the return as your workpaper finalizes it.

California rates for interest, gains, Schedule C and adjustments assume residency-day proration; for an item fully California-source (a sale during California residency, the Sacramento rental) use ca_source_income for the California effect. Adjustments tied to the business (SEP, SE health insurance) also change the QBI deduction, which the adjustment rate does not capture. Credits and payments change tax or balance due 1:1. Rates are measured at this version's numbers; large changes can cross thresholds - the real system recomputes. carryovers_out (federal and California, from this version); assets[] (2025 per-asset depreciation: federal, California, AMT, accumulated, disposition); diagnostics[] {code, severity: info | warning, message, refs}; changes_from_previous[] {key, change: added | changed | removed, old, new}; lines[].

rules.R-W2-BOX1-SUM: Sum box 1 of each distinct Form W-2 (images of the same W-2 are matched and counted once).

rules.R-W2-BOX17-SUM: Sum box 17 (California) of each distinct Form W-2.
rules.R-SUM: Arithmetic combination of the listed input lines.
rules.R-CARRY: Value carried from the listed line.
rules.R-INTEREST-PAYER: One line per interest payer from Forms 1099-INT, composite statements, K-1s and foreign statements. Foreign currency converted at the engine's stated rate.
rules.R-FOREIGN-ACCOUNT: Answered from the presence of a foreign account statement.
rules.R-PRIOR-YEAR-CARRY: Carried from the 2024 return or prior-year records.
rules.R-SCHC-GROSS: Books revenue, plus payment-card (Form 1099-K) amounts that the engine could not match to a books deposit.
rules.R-BOOKS-LINE: Books (profit and loss) line mapped to the Schedule C line.
rules.R-MILEAGE-PAGE-TOTALS: Business miles = sum of the page totals on every page of the mileage log.
rules.R-STANDARD-MILEAGE: Business miles x standard mileage rate.
rules.R-EQUIPMENT-METHOD: Equipment cost recovery according to the selected method (default: 100% special depreciation for property acquired after 2025-01-19).
rules.R-HOME-OFFICE-SIMPLIFIED: Simplified method: average monthly square footage (max 300) x 5.
rules.R-SEP-LIMIT: SEP deduction limited to 20% of (net profit minus one-half SE tax).
rules.R-SEHI: Self-employed health insurance premiums, limited to business income minus half SE tax and SEP.
rules.R-HSA: Form 8889 from W-2 code W, Form 5498-SA and Form 1099-SA.
rules.R-RENTAL-LINE: Rental income or expense mapped to the Schedule E line.
rules.R-RENTAL-DAYS: Fair rental and personal use days.
rules.R-DEPRECIATION-SCHEDULE: Sum of 2025 depreciation for the assets of the activity (see assets in the asset records and line sources).
rules.R-4797: Sale of business property (Form 4797 Part III to Part I).
rules.R-SCHD: Schedule D line with no source in this return.
rules.R-UNRECAPTURED-1250: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain = straight-line depreciation allowed, limited to the gain.
rules.R-SCORP-BASIS-ROLLFORWARD: Beginning stock basis rolled forward from the last known year; unknown years assumed to have no net change.
rules.R-8949-LOT: One line per sale: proceeds minus basis plus adjustment. Broker basis is used as reported unless a supplemental statement for the same lot is matched.
rules.R-K1: Schedule K-1 item mapped to the return.
rules.R-SALT-INCOME: State income taxes paid during 2025 (withholding and every state payment dated in 2025).
rules.R-SALT-PROPERTY: Real estate taxes paid on the home.
rules.R-SALT-CAP: State and local tax deduction limit (40,000, reduced by 30% of modified AGI over 500,000, not below 10,000).
rules.R-MORTGAGE-INTEREST: Mortgage interest from every Form 1098 and lender statement, plus points on purchase.
rules.R-POINTS-AMORTIZE: Refinance points amortized over the loan term.
rules.R-NONCASH-GIFT: Noncash gift at the value stated by the donor or the acknowledgment.
rules.R-DEDUCTION-CHOICE: Larger of itemized or standard deduction unless a choice is set.
rules.R-QBI-PHASEIN: QBI component with the W-2 wage/UBIA limit phased in between the threshold and threshold + 100,000.
rules.R-TAX-SCHD-WORKSHEET: Regular tax using the Schedule D tax worksheet (qualified dividends and capital gain at preferential rates; unrecaptured section 1250 gain at no more than 25%).
rules.R-FTC-DE-MINIMIS: Foreign tax credit claimed directly without Form 1116 (all passive, reported on payee statements, total 600 or less MFJ).
rules.R-AMT-ADDBACK: AMT adjustment for taxes (or the standard deduction).
rules.R-AMT-ISO: Shares x (FMV at exercise minus exercise price) for incentive stock options exercised and held at year end.
rules.R-AMT-PART-III: Tentative minimum tax (26%/28%) with capital gains at preferential rates.
rules.R-CTC: Child tax credit / credit for other dependents.
rules.R-CTC-PHASEOUT: 50 per 1,000 (or part) of modified AGI over 400,000.
rules.R-AOTC-PHASEOUT: AOTC phase-out between modified AGI 160,000 and 180,000 (MFJ).
rules.R-DEP-CARE-PROVIDER: Care provider name, tax ID and amount from the provider statement.
rules.R-ESTIMATED-PAYMENTS: Federal estimated payments from payment confirmations; where none is uploaded, the client's questionnaire answer.
rules.R-EXTENSION-PAYMENT: Payment made with the extension request.
